Rotating.description: Continuously rotates an object over the animation duration
Rotating.use_when: Object needs to spin/rotate smoothly over time

key_parameters.angle: Total rotation angle in radians (e.g., TAU for one full spin)
key_parameters.axis: The axis to rotate around (e.g., OUT, UP, RIGHT)
key_parameters.run_time: The duration of the rotation animation

Rotating.differences: Unlike Rotate, this animates continuously over run_time and doesn't necessarily have a fixed 'target' state.

Rotate.description: Rotates an object from its current state to a rotated state
Rotate.use_when: Object needs to reach a specific rotated orientation
Rotate.differences: Unlike Rotating, this is a Transform animation that targets a specific end state.

FadeIn.description: Smoothly fade objects from transparent to opaque
FadeIn.use_when: Objects should appear gradually and softly

key_parameters.shift: Optional direction to slide in from while fading
key_parameters.scale: Optional initial scale factor (object grows while fading in)
key_parameters.target_position: Point or object to move towards while fading in

FadeOut.description: Smoothly fade objects from opaque to transparent
FadeOut.use_when: Objects should disappear gradually and softly

key_parameters.shift: Optional direction to slide towards while fading out
key_parameters.scale: Optional final scale factor (object shrinks while fading out)
key_parameters.target_position: Point or object to move towards while fading out

Create.description: Incrementally show a VMobject by drawing its strokes
Create.use_when: A vectorized object (like a square or circle) needs to be drawn onto the scene

key_parameters.lag_ratio: Delay between drawing different submobjects (0.0 to 1.0)

Uncreate.description: Like Create but in reverse, erasing the object
Uncreate.use_when: An object needs to be erased by 'un-drawing' its strokes

DrawBorderThenFill.description: Draw the border first and then show the fill color
DrawBorderThenFill.use_when: Emphasizing a shape's outline before making it fully solid

key_parameters.stroke_width: Width of the border during drawing
key_parameters.stroke_color: Color of the border during drawing

Write.description: Simulate hand-writing a Text or hand-drawing a VMobject
Write.use_when: Introducing text or complex line drawings in a natural-looking way

key_parameters.reverse: If True, simulates erasing instead of writing

Write.differences: Specialized version of DrawBorderThenFill tailored for text and complex VMobjects.

Unwrite.description: Simulate erasing text or a VMobject by hand
Unwrite.use_when: Removing text as if it's being erased

TypeWithCursor.description: Show text character by character with a moving cursor effect
TypeWithCursor.use_when: Simulating a computer terminal or live typing effect

key_parameters.cursor: The Mobject to use as a cursor (e.g., a small rectangle)
key_parameters.leave_cursor_on: Whether to keep the cursor visible after typing

SpiralIn.description: Objects fly in from a distance on spiral trajectories
SpiralIn.use_when: Creating a dynamic and energetic introduction for a group of objects

key_parameters.scale_factor: Initial scale of objects (usually very high)
key_parameters.fade_in_fraction: Fraction of runtime spent fading in

Transform.description: Morphs a Mobject into a target Mobject
Transform.use_when: One object needs to smoothly change into a completely different shape, color, or position

key_parameters.path_arc: Angle of rotation for the path between states
key_parameters.path_func: Custom function defining the transition path

ReplacementTransform.description: Morphs a mobject and replaces it with the target in the scene
ReplacementTransform.use_when: The original object identity is no longer needed after the transformation

key_parameters.target_mobject: The object that will stay in the scene

ReplacementTransform.differences: Unlike Transform, the original object is removed from the scene's memory and replaced by the target.

FadeToColor.use_when: Changing the color of an existing object without changing its shape

ScaleInPlace.description: Scales an object relative to its own center
ScaleInPlace.use_when: Making an object grow or shrink without shifting its position

Restore.description: Reverts an object to its last saved state
Restore.use_when: An object was modified and needs to return to its original form using save_state()

CyclicReplace.description: Moves multiple objects cyclically to each other's positions
CyclicReplace.use_when: Multiple objects need to swap places in a loop

key_parameters.mobjects: List of objects to be cycled

FocusOn.description: Shrinks a spotlight effect onto a specific point or object
FocusOn.use_when: Directing the viewer's eye to a precise location

key_parameters.focus_point: The point or object to spotlight

Indicate.description: Temporarily resizes and recolors an object to draw attention
Indicate.use_when: Briefly highlighting an object without making a permanent change

key_parameters.scale_factor: How much to grow during the indication

Flash.description: Sends out short lines from a central point like a burst
Flash.use_when: Emphasizing a sudden event or a specific coordinate

Wiggle.description: Shakes an object back and forth
Wiggle.use_when: Indicating instability, error, or simply making an object more noticeable

Circumscribe.description: Draws a temporary rectangle or circle around an object
Circumscribe.use_when: Highlighting an object or group by 'boxing it in'

MoveAlongPath.description: Moves an object along the curve of another Mobject
MoveAlongPath.use_when: An object needs to follow a specific geometric path precisely

key_parameters.path: The VMobject (Line, Curve, etc.) to follow

ChangeDecimalToValue.description: Animates a DecimalNumber counter to a new value
ChangeDecimalToValue.use_when: Updating a stat, timer, or counter on screen

TransformMatchingTex.description: Morphs one LaTeX equation into another by matching common parts
TransformMatchingTex.use_when: Transforming mathematical expressions where terms move to new positions

key_parameters.key_map: Manual overrides for matching specific parts

AnimationGroup.use_when: Independent actions should happen at the same time

key_parameters.lag_ratio: Delay between starts of included animations

Succession.use_when: Actions must happen in a specific chronological order
